For those who are keen to help test, key attention should be paid to the Q hotkey (which deletes objects) and the Z hotkeky (which adds computer monitors to the game world). If anyone spots any objects which are non deleteable via the Q hotkey, I would love to hear about it!

Thanks a bunch everyone!
